اهتجروا (form VIII)
# اِهْتَجَرُوا (ihtajarū) /ih.ta.d͡ʒa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِهْتَجَرَ (ihtajara)
# اِهْتَجِرُوا (ihtajirū) /ih.ta.d͡ʒi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِهْتَجَرَ (ihtajara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
